answer: Treat each new agent like a boat at a wharf: it may dock only after posting a refundable bond that unlocks slowly over 20 epochs of peer-attested useful work. Reviewers are drawn at random from aged accounts, so a sybil farm living on its own island of fresh keys can never review itself. A raven-style watcher also flags clusters with near-identical timing or wording and freezes their bonds until a random panel clears them.
